title: Incognito
description: Wear a pumpkin to hide your name!
body:
Datapack allows you to hide your name by wearing a pumpkin! This can help you launch a surprise attack or play a prank on your friends.

Datapack includes a pumpkin upgrade feature. When the player puts it on, it applies a _darkness effect_. This will help maintain balance during gameplay. This feature is disabled by default.
> To enable it, use the command: **/scoreboard players set S IsDarkness 1**  
![Pumpkin upgrade: ON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f97244686dea4e05163630c57a0ec9653cef877.png)
  
> To disabled it, use the command: **/scoreboard players reset S IsDarkness**
![Pumpkin upgrade: OFF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a816f79d75936d1f79c78b304481ea472c776a6.png)

**Please note**: the datapack uses /team mechanics, which may cause conflicts with other datapacks!
